source.citation: D. Ongari et al., Building a consistent and reproducible database for adsorption evaluation in Covalent-Organic Frameworks, Materials Cloud Archive 2021.100 (2021), DOI: 10.24435/materialscloud:z6-jn.

source.conditions: The source archive describes DFT-optimized coordinates and unit cell. The original 2009 COF-300 report assigned five interpenetrated diamond frameworks (DOI: 10.1021/ja8096256). This entry identifies only CURATED record 09000N3 and does not represent other interpenetration or pore-form variants. Source CIF charge metadata remains raw-only.
